$comment: Per-file strictNullChecks allowlist (docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md §8). The whole-project flip has no per-file granularity, so modules graduate ONE AT A TIME: the main tsconfig EXCLUDES every file listed here, and each must hold strictNullChecks + noUncheckedIndexedAccess clean. The config also SNC-checks every file the listed ones transitively IMPORT (TypeScript follows relative imports), so a closure leaf must stay clean even when it has not graduated itself (raccoon.ts's one never[] fix). Graduated: the whole client half (qr/cards/account-form/panel-page — failure mode is a mis-drawn panel, never a locked account) and the host data/parse layer (state-store/catalog-store/parsers/llm-models/raccoon-models). LAST, only after frame-by-frame review like the store-baseline split: the login-path files (routes/token-store/auth/publish/stores holding credentials). A graduating file moves into `include` here AND into the main config's `exclude` — both in the same commit, or typecheck-gate runs it twice under different rules.
